stops.note: named for the sound of its bark-like call
Cape Dutch settlers adopted the Khoikhoi name for the striped plains animal
adopted into English natural history before the animal's extinction in 1883
stops.meaning: an extinct subspecies of plains zebra

current_meaning: An extinct subspecies of plains zebra, partially striped, that once lived in South Africa; the name also now labels the invasive quagga mussel.
